items.name: Dobřejovice 4BLD Madness 2027
items.information: The competition takes place in Dobřejovice with 3 rounds of 4BLD and Head-to-head finals.

items.name: Glasgow Open 2027

venue.name: Woodside Hall
venue.details: Main Hall, Ground Floor, accessible from front main doors.

items.information: Everyone is welcome to compete in this competition, and all competitors are eligible to win medals for podium positions. However, if you are a newer competitor, you may be more interested in the [Glasgow Beginners 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowBeginners2027) competition. **PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Glasgow Beginners 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowBeginners2027). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowOpen2027#82796-series-competition-information). Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

items.name: Menomonie Mixup 2027
items.information: This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3RsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d783e6bc8ef9637fd7108a6fcfdc60829bd500da/image.png) We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480), [Wisconsin & Illinois Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473), and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.name: Morrow Quiet Mania 2027
items.information: This competition takes place on **SATURDAY** and only features Square-1, FMC, and Blindfolded events. Therefore, it may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorrowMixupMania2027) to view the page for the Morrow Mixup Mania 2027 competition which does feature 3x3, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/) Morrow Quiet Mania 2027 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTQ4MDEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1799465e8f962e1cc618cf35c06c44a48142c2fe/image.png) contact@midwestcubing.org

items.name: Porterville Spring 2027

venue.name: Hillside Community Church
venue.address: 1091 W Linda Vista Avenue, Porterville, CA

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortervilleSpring2027#79300-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please. No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.
